dims.label: Type of site
dims.help: Contributor platforms (Mercor, Outlier...), data companies' own job boards, AI labs, big tech.

dims.label: Field
dims.help: Guessed from the job title by keywords, so some jobs land in the wrong field.

dims.label: Degree mentioned
dims.help: Highest degree the listing mentions (mentioned, not necessarily required).

dims.label: Experience asked
dims.help: Smallest number of years of experience the listing asks for.

dims.label: Who can apply
dims.help: Whether the listing limits where you must live or work.
values: Place listed, not said if required

dims.label: Kind of job
dims.help: Contractor unless the listing says otherwise; permanent only when stated.

dims.label: Paid per
dims.help: What the pay figure is for. Salaries are shown per hour at 40 hours a week.

dims.label: How pay is stated
dims.help: A fixed figure or range, or one that varies or is only an "up to" (likely lower).

dims.label: Currency
dims.help: "$" with no currency is taken as US$; other currencies are converted at the day's rate.
